title: LinkedIn Email Finder | Exact Personal Match
description: LinkedIn email finder for a profile URL you already have. Returns a personal Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, or Hotmail only when the match is 100% exact. No match, no charge. 400M+ records, Starting from $30 per 1,000 found. You supply the URL. Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.

lawfulUse.title: Professional use and lawful basis
lawfulUse.description: This run is for professional outreach, recruiting, or account-based marketing, and you have a lawful basis to use a match. Mawsool does not send the email for you. Leaving this off does not stop the run.

urls.title: LinkedIn profile URLs
urls.description: Profile URLs you already have. One sample link is shown here. If you add your own URLs, delete the sample. Leave the CSV box empty when you use this list. After a match, check quality in Email to LinkedIn: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-email-linkedin-lookup

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: Optional. A url or linkedinUrl column, or one profile URL per line. Leave this empty when the list above already has your URLs. Sample rows left in this box are not looked up.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column. HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, and recruiter exports all work.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Cost-control cap. Maximum 50,000. You pay only for profiles that return a personal email.

concurrency.title: Concurrent lookups
concurrency.description: How many profiles to look up at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip profiles that already returned an email.

freshStart.title: Look up finished profiles again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
